{{Quote|At the heart of the field is ''Annamar''&mdash;a planetoid with a breathable atmosphere.|[[Luca/Legends|Luca]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWA" />}}
'''Annamar''' was a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] located within a vast [[Annamar asteroid field|asteroid field]].

==History==
{{Quote|Long ago, in the time of the Old Republic, Annamar was the base of a manufacturing company. Their factory specialized in experimental battle droids. The Rebels use the abandoned droid factory as their headquarters.|[[Luca/Legends|Luca]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWA" />}}
The [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] was home to a [[Abandoned droid factory|droid factory]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] which specialized in experimental [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. After it was abandoned, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used the factory as a base, conducting raids on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. After [[Ambush on the Corellian Trade Spine|stealing]] a [[Imperial convoy ship|cargo ship]] carrying a vital piece of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] weapons systems, the Rebel [[Wolf Squadron]] unit brought it to Annamar. Shortly after, it was the site of the [[Battle of Annamar]], which saw [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] decimate the entire base, kill all its personnel and retrieve the piece.<ref name="SWA" />
